title: rest: the /meta dashboard item and list reads pass no packaged base to translateDashboard, so a published org overlay on a translated dashboard keeps the shipped widget title — per-layer child of #20680
body:
Filing gate: **④ a coordination node, the per-layer child of #20680**, as #20680's triage (5895803688) ordered: "If the fix lands in `packages/rest`'s read path, that face is a per-layer child." It is also a product defect with a measured `reach:`: `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/system_overview` and `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard`. The #20680 dev measured both in a real showcase boot, as an admin and as a member of the same org, in `en` and `zh-CN`, on `origin/main` `5757463712` (`os-dev-report` 5900307018 on #20680, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). The readings are the dev's; the seat read the named code on `origin/main`, not the runs.

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01DEvba2nBuD4tWzfq8r8NFY`, `os-support-ai`). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: triage, then the seat of the lane that owns the `/meta` doors in `packages/rest`.

Blocked-by: #20728

## What happens

A published org overlay on `system_overview` changes a widget title to `Total Users (edited-20680)`. `?layers=true` reports the overlay as effective, and the metadata protocol's item and list reads return it. The `/meta` item and list doors still serve `Total Users` (`en`) and `用户总数` (`zh-CN`). The console draws the board from the list door.

## Why

- The i18n catalog (`dashboards.system_overview.widgets.<id>.title`, which `platform-objects` ships in `en` too) is applied over the served document in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, by `translateMetaDocument` / `translateMetaList` through `translateMetadataDocument('dashboard', …)`.
- `packagedObjectBaseOf(...)` hands a `packagedBase` for objects only. For a dashboard it is `undefined`, so the catalog wins over any authored string.
- PR #20728 (#20680) adds the other two halves:
  - `translateDashboard` lets an explicit override beat the packaged catalog when handed `packagedBase` (ADR-0029 D9.2a, the #8284 comparison);
  - `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedDashboardBase(name)` answers that base.

  Neither half changes a served answer by itself, which this card fixes.

## Scope for whoever takes it

- `packagedObjectBaseOf` (or its successor) passes `protocol.getPackagedDashboardBase(name)` for `dashboard`. `translateMetaDocument` and `translateMetaList` resolve the protocol for a dashboard too.
- The #20680 dev measured a throwaway 9-line version of this on top of PR #20728: exactly 16 served fields change, all of them the edited widget, and the pins go green.
- **Pins** (#20680 triage's list): after an overlay and a publish, the plain item read, the list read and the board all serve the edit, for the admin and for a member, in `en` and `zh-CN`. The unedited widget stays translated. A reset restores the shipped body. The showcase dashboard control is unchanged.
- **Carried here, not filed:**
  - The browser check of the board. objectui's `DashboardRenderer` `tWidgetTitle` (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`, read by the dev at objectui `9fd6c2c`, not at the pinned `dd3f7e1`) re-resolves `dashboards.NAME.widgets.WIDGET_ID.title` on the client. A bundle entry may win over the served title, so the rendered board may keep the shipped string after this card serves the edit. That is a read-only inference; if it holds, it is an objectui card.
  - `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` states the dashboard catalog-vs-override rule once it becomes observable. The object rule is documented in `data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` only.

## Dedupe

- "dashboard overlay translation catalog widget title packagedBase meta-item-read-gate": 15 hits. Control: #20680, the parent. None is this door; #8721, #5428 and #7862 are widget-title translation cards, all closed.
- "explicit override beats packaged default translation catalog object label overlay": 4 hits, none about dashboards.
